import boto3


def translate_text(text, source_lang, target_lang):
    client = boto3.client('translate')
    response = client.translate_text(Text=text, SourceLanguageCode=source_lang, TargetLanguageCode=target_lang)
    return response['TranslatedText']

import boto3


def embed_text(text):
    client = boto3.client('comprehend')
    response = client.detect_dominant_language(Text=text)
    lang_code = response['Languages'][0]['LanguageCode']
    embeddings = client.detect_sentiment(Text=text, LanguageCode=lang_code)['SentimentScore']
    return embeddings
